title: 会说话的鹦鹉与企鹅伴侣之谜
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol44/Vol44_晚读讲义_会说话的鹦鹉与企鹅伴侣之谜_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today's stories are about love and courage in the animal world. First, a talking parrot who became a fire hero. Then, penguins — do they stay with one partner for life? Let's find out!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天的故事都和动物世界的爱与勇气有关。首先，一只会说话的鹦鹉成了消防小英雄。然后，企鹅——它们真的会一生只守着一个伴侣吗？我们一起来找答案！

blocks.en: In a small town in France, there lives a parrot named Baby. Baby is an African grey parrot, and like many parrots, he can copy human words. But Baby does something very special at night: he stays quiet. His owners say they never hear him after bedtime.
blocks.title: 鹦鹉小英雄
blocks.cn: 在法国的一个小镇上，住着一只叫 Baby 的鹦鹉。Baby 是一只非洲灰鹦鹉，和很多鹦鹉一样，它会模仿人类说话。但 Baby 有个很特别的地方：到了晚上，它就安静下来。它的主人说，睡觉之后从来听不到它出声。

blocks.en: One night, everything changed. Baby started to cough, again and again, and then he yelled, 'It's hot! It's hot!' His owners woke up at once. They knew something was wrong, because Baby never talks at night. They followed the smell through a curtain of smoke and found a fire behind their dishwasher. They turned it off quickly and called the firefighters.
blocks.title: 鹦鹉小英雄
blocks.cn: 有一天夜里，一切都变了。Baby 开始不停地咳嗽，然后大喊：“好热！好热！”主人们一下子就醒了。他们知道出事了，因为 Baby 晚上从来不说话。他们顺着气味穿过一帘浓烟，找到了洗碗机后面的火。他们迅速关掉电源，叫来了消防员。

blocks.en: The firefighters remarked that without Baby's warning, the family might have breathed in dangerous smoke in their sleep. Baby became a hero! Parrots are clever birds. Scientists have found that African grey parrots can learn many words and even understand some simple ideas. Baby did not just copy sounds — he used his words at the right moment, and that made the difference.
blocks.title: 鹦鹉小英雄
blocks.cn: 消防员说，如果没有 Baby 的警告，这家人可能在睡梦中吸入危险的浓烟。Baby 成了英雄！鹦鹉是很聪明的鸟。科学家发现，非洲灰鹦鹉能学会很多词，甚至能理解一些简单的意思。Baby 不只是模仿声音——它在最关键的时刻用上了自己的话，这就带来了完全不同的结果。

blocks.en: Now, from a talking hero, let's waddle down to the cold south, where penguins live. People often say penguins stay with one partner for life. Is that true? Let me clarify: it depends! Most penguins stay with one partner for a breeding season. They share the work: keeping the egg warm, finding food, and protecting the chick.
blocks.title: 企鹅伴侣之谜
blocks.cn: 现在，从这位会说话的英雄身边，我们摇摇摆摆走到寒冷的南方，去看看企鹅生活的地方。人们常说企鹅会一生只守着一个伴侣。这是真的吗？先澄清一点：这要看情况！大多数企鹅会在整个繁殖季节里守着一个伴侣。它们分工合作：给蛋保暖、找食物、保护小企鹅。

blocks.en: Some penguins are faithful. Gentoo penguins return to the same partner about nine times out of ten, and Magellanic penguins also stay together year after year. But other penguins are different. Emperor penguins usually find a new partner each year, and king penguins change partners even more often. Scientists studied twelve kinds of penguins and found that, in total, about seven out of ten pairs stay together from one year to the next.
blocks.title: 企鹅伴侣之谜
blocks.cn: 有些企鹅非常忠诚。巴布亚企鹅大约十次里有九次会回到同一个伴侣身边，麦哲伦企鹅也常常年复一年地在一起。但另一些企鹅不一样。帝企鹅通常每年会找一个新伴侣，王企鹅换伴侣还要更频繁。科学家研究了十二种企鹅，发现总的来说，大约十对里有七对会从一年相守到下一年。

blocks.en: Why do penguins change partners? Sometimes the old partner comes back too late, or the pair fails to raise a chick, so they try again with someone new. And here is a lovely detail: a male penguin often brings his partner a smooth pebble as a gift. If she accepts it, they build a nest together. So penguins may not always stay together for life, but they take their family duties very seriously — and that is something to appreciate.
blocks.title: 企鹅伴侣之谜
blocks.cn: 企鹅为什么会换伴侣呢？有时候，老伴侣回来得太晚了，或者一对企鹅没能把小企鹅养大，于是它们就和新的伴侣再试一次。还有一个可爱的细节：雄企鹅常常会送给伴侣一颗光滑的小石子作为礼物。如果她接受了，它们就一起筑巢。所以，企鹅不一定一生只守着一个伴侣，但它们对待家庭责任非常认真——这一点值得我们珍惜。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: 'the ball is in your court.' In a ball game, when the ball is in your court, it is your turn to play. In everyday life, it means it is your turn to act or to decide. Here's an example: 'The firefighters showed us how to stay safe. Now the ball is in your court — check the smoke alarm in your home with your parents!' So, young explorers, the ball is in your court: what will you do?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“the ball is in your court”（球在你的场地上）。在球类比赛中，球在你的场地上，就轮到你打球了。在日常生活中，它的意思是轮到你行动、轮到你做决定了。举个例子：“消防员教了我们怎样保持安全。现在，球在你的场地上——和爸爸妈妈一起检查一下家里的烟雾报警器吧！”所以，小小探险家们，球在你的场地上：你打算做点什么呢？

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories. First: Baby the parrot used his words to save his family. If your pet could say one sentence to you, what would you want it to say? Second: penguins share their family work and sometimes change partners. Do you think staying together for life matters most, or is taking good care of the family more important? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事。第一：鹦鹉 Baby 用自己的话救了全家人。如果你的宠物能对你说一句话，你希望它说什么？第二：企鹅分工照顾家庭，有时候也会换伴侣。你觉得一生相守最重要，还是好好照顾家庭更重要？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Keep listening, keep caring, and remember: when someone gives you a chance, the ball is in your court! See you tomorrow!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。继续聆听，继续关爱，还要记住：当别人给你一个机会时，球就在你的场地上！明天见！

children.text: The firefighters remarked that without Baby's warning, the family might have breathed in dangerous smoke in their sleep.
that without Baby's warning, the family might have breathed in dangerous smoke in their sleep
：remarked（说）后面跟 that + 一整句话，that 把这句话变成 remark 的内容——消防员说了什么？说了“如果没有 Baby 的警告，一家人可能在睡梦中吸入危险的浓烟”。that 在这里只起连接作用，译成中文时常常不用译出。
：without（如果没有）+ 名词，放在句首说明前提——没有这个警告会怎样？后面 might have breathed in（可能已经吸入）就是结果。
：might have + 过去分词，表示“过去可能已经……”，不是肯定发生了，而是“差一点就发生”，语气比 must 弱，带着一丝侥幸。
观点（消防员说）→ 条件（如果没有警告）→ 推测结果（可能吸入浓烟）
。一句话里藏着宾语从句、条件短语和过去推测三个机关。
"Baby started to cough, again and again, and then he yelled, 'It's hot! It's hot!'"
"They followed the smell through a curtain of smoke and found a fire behind their dishwasher."
"Emperor penguins usually find a new partner each year."
"It means it is your turn to act or to decide."
